name: chromatic-image
title: Chromatic Image
description: A landscape photo on a rounded canvas that warps into horizontal bands and splits into shifted colour copies under the pointer, tilting in 3D and easing back when the pointer leaves.
use: A hero or feature image needs a tactile, pointer-reactive treatment that makes a still photo feel physical.
avoid: Touch devices: the effect needs a pointer, and the canvas is hidden from screen readers.
a11y: The effect is pointer-only and the canvas is hidden from assistive tech, though the fallback image keeps its alt text. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A wide rounded photo of snowy peaks above a sea of cloud at dawn, with a dark gradient washing the lower edge. Small tracked capital letters and a white headline sit at the bottom left, a quiet hint at the bottom right, and the whole frame leans slightly.
behaves: Moving the pointer warps the picture in horizontal bands, offsets the red, green and blue channels and tilts it toward the cursor. Leaving the frame lets it settle back flat and sharp.
customise: Image source, alt text and overlay children come through props; zoom, displacement, chromatic shift, tilt and background colour are numeric props, while size comes from class names.
weight: heavy: A WebGL shader redraws the full image while the pointer moves; it idles once settled.
